reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — user input from request.getParameterValues flows through doSomething where it is HTML-encoded to bar, then bar is converted to bytes and re-encoded at the sink (encodeForHTML(new String(input))) before printing to response.getWriter(). The resolved sink value is encodeForHTML(user_input_bytes) which still outputs attacker-controlled data to HTML context. Double encoding occurs but user input still reaches the HTML response, satisfying the XSS condition.

First encoding: param is HTML-encoded to bar in doSomething method
Sink: encodeForHTML(new String(input)) writes user-controlled data to HTML response
